message.const: the Run changed after the caller's view

machine_snapshot.description: Closed materialized Machine projection for genesis, open, and audit; it is never a standalone physical storage record.

agent_workspace_checkpoint.description: Exact bounded Agent/M1 source and result neighborhood. Its enclosing coupled receipt admits at most 12 canonical MiB; Rust verifies content identities and source/result equality at the pinned StateRoot.

machine_delta.description: Admitted semantic Machine transition lowered directly into StateRoot paths; it is not a persisted segment payload.

durable_delta.description: Closed semantic transition consumed by StateRoot lowering; providers never persist it as a recursive delta or suffix authority.

durable_state.description: Materialized semantic projection used only for genesis, open, and audit; it is not a checkpoint envelope or physical authority.

ordered_root.description: The canonical empty-log commitment when len is zero; otherwise exactly the node content identity. Rust verifies the cross-field equality.

canonical_json.$comment: Exact canonical UTF-8 JSON text. Rust additionally enforces the 12 MiB UTF-8 byte bound, strict typed decoding, and canonical round-trip equality; maxLength is only the necessary Unicode-scalar ceiling. Numeric byte arrays have no compatibility decoder.

bytes.$comment: Nonempty arbitrary binary chunks use canonical padded standard Base64 and at most 4 MiB decoded bytes. A chunk may split UTF-8; at maximum encoded length two padding characters are required. Rust checks decoded length and unused padding bits before output allocation.
